levels.label: Emerging
levels.descriptor: Lists fewer than six items, or quantities are missing or clearly estimated without actually looking.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: Lists at least six real items with quantities and a low/adequate/full label applied consistently using the stated rule.

levels.label: Advanced
levels.descriptor: Lists six or more items accurately labeled, and correctly flags an edge case (an item that doesn't fit neatly into one category) with a reasonable resolution.

levels.label: Emerging
levels.descriptor: Names items to restock without any stated reason, or the reason is generic.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: Names two items to restock first with a specific, plausible reason for the priority order.

levels.label: Advanced
levels.descriptor: Names two items with specific reasoning and weighs multiple factors (usage rate, number of people, substitutability) explicitly.

lookFors: The inventoried items are genuinely from the chosen category rather than a mismatched or padded list.
The restock order reasoning connects to the quantities actually recorded, not to an unrelated assumption.

nonDiagnosticGuard: Do not infer effort, motivation, diagnosis, or character from an error.
